en: Black‑and‑white aerial photograph of a large villa-like building surrounded by trees and gardens. In front of the main building is a circular driveway with a decorative round flower bed or fountain in the center. The property is bordered by roads and open fields, with several smaller houses and farm buildings in the background. Printed caption text appears along the bottom edge, and a small publisher's mark is in the lower right corner.
